info.title: Evergarden API v1
info.description: API de Evergarden. El contrato escrito vive en docs/api/; este documento se genera desde el código y debe coincidir con él. Todas las fechas son UTC ISO-8601 con Z.

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/posts/{post}/comments — public. Top-level comments with their
one level of replies

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/posts/{post}/request-consent — the post author nudges the
pending request again. Idempotent; re-notification is best-effort

get.summary: GET /api/v1/consent-requests — posts waiting on my consent

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Sincronización delta: sólo lo cambiado después de esta marca de agua. Usa el `meta.synced_at` de la respuesta anterior, nunca el reloj del cliente (docs/api/_convenciones.md).

deleted_ids.description:
Only meaningful during a delta: on a full sync, whatever the
client doesn't receive is deleted by definition.

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/doll-requests/{id}/messages — ascending, oldest first: a
transcript is read forwards, unlike the mailbox

GET /api/v1/dolls/{handle} — `{handle}` is the Doll's `postal_handle`,
the same public identifier used everywhere else (`GET /users/{handle}`,
recipients on send). A deviation from the contract's literal `{id}`
(docs/api/dolls.md) for URL-friendliness and consistency

post.summary: POST /api/v1/doll-requests/{id}/drafts — the Doll shares a new version

POST /api/v1/doll-requests/{id}/drafts/{draft}/approve — the client
accepts a version. This is what completes the request and mints the
letter; there is no standalone `/complete` endpoint (docs/api/dolls.md)

POST /api/v1/doll-requests — `doll_handle` resolves to the Doll's
`doll_profiles` row; rejects if unverified, unavailable, or at capacity

POST /api/v1/doll-requests/{id}/rate — the client rates a completed
request, once. The profile aggregate is NOT touched here: it is derived,
and RecalculateDollRatingsJob owns it (hourly). Writing both from here
would make the average drift the first time anything is corrected
POST /auth/email/verify/{id}/{hash} — public, authenticated by the signed URL

get.description:
The response shape is declared explicitly because Scramble infers
`JsonResource::$resource` as `mixed` for a resource that wraps an array
instead of a model, and would otherwise publish `features: string`.

POST /api/v1/mailbox/{delivery}/open-correspondence — either party opts in

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Búsqueda full-text sobre título y cuerpo (Postgres, configuración `spanish`). Acepta comillas para frase exacta y `-palabra` para excluir. Ordena por relevancia.

get.summary: GET /users/{postal_handle} — minimal public profile, exact handle only

GET /api/v1/random/quota — what the sender has left, and why they might
not be able to send (docs/api/botella-al-mar.md)

post.summary: POST /api/v1/letters/{letter}/send — one queued delivery per recipient

get.description:
Public. Returns the country's helplines plus the global fallback rows,
most prominent first. Surfaced by the moderation filter on a self-harm
signal and always reachable from settings.

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/push/vapid-public-key — public. The browser needs this to
create a PushSubscription. `enabled` is false when no keys are configured

AssignOccurrenceLetterRequest.description:
PUT /schedules/{id}/occurrences/{date}/letter — pin a letter to one date, or
clear it with `letter_id: null`.
AssignOccurrenceLetterRequest.title: AssignOccurrenceLetterRequest

pii_flags.description: Non-empty means the contact-exchange filter flagged this line.

rating_avg.description: null until there are enough ratings to mean anything (config/dolls.php).

DollRateType.description: How a Doll charges, if at all (docs/api/dolls.md §Pagos). Stripe Connect is deliberately not implemented yet — `free` avoids the legal/fiscal complexity while the module gets validated (ADR-0012).
DollRateType.title: DollRateType

LeapDayPolicy.description: What a yearly schedule anchored on 29 February does in a common year (docs/api/programaciones.md).
LeapDayPolicy.title: LeapDayPolicy

has_doll_profile.description: Filled in by later modules (Dolls, Mailbox).

my_reactions.description:
My own reactions, for the toggle UI. Counts are never exposed
publicly (docs/api/blog.md).

PostType.description: Kinds of blog publication (docs/api/blog.md). Only `shared_letter` — a received letter republished with the recipient's testimony — needs the original author's consent.
PostType.title: PostType

PostVisibility.description: Who can reach a published post (docs/api/blog.md). `unlisted` is reachable by direct link only — never in the feed.
PostVisibility.title: PostVisibility

is_blocked_by_me.description: Wired to the blocks module in Fase 1; until then nobody is blocked.

RateDollRequestRequest.description: The client rates a completed request, once (docs/api/dolls.md).
RateDollRequestRequest.title: RateDollRequestRequest

ReactionType.description: The only reactions the blog allows — no generic "like" (docs/api/blog.md). Counts are never shown publicly and never drive ranking.
ReactionType.title: ReactionType

RecurrenceType.description: How a `letter_schedule` repeats (docs/api/programaciones.md). `custom_dates` reads its dates from the schedule's `custom_dates` array; every other type steps off the `anchor_date`.
RecurrenceType.title: RecurrenceType

ReplyAnonymousRequest.description:
The single reply the recipient of a random letter may send back down the same
anonymous channel (docs/api/botella-al-mar.md).
ReplyAnonymousRequest.title: ReplyAnonymousRequest

ReportableType.description: The report target kinds exposed on the API (docs/api/comunidad-notificaciones.md). Only the ones whose models exist are wired; the rest arrive with their modules.
ReportableType.title: ReportableType

mode.description: Random ("botella al mar") arrives in Fase 2.

message_to_stranger.description:
A short note shown to the stranger. Accepted for forward
compatibility; not persisted yet (docs/api/botella-al-mar.md).

StoreDollChatMessageRequest.description:
A line of Doll chat. `system` is not accepted from a client — only the
platform writes those (contact-exchange warnings).
StoreDollChatMessageRequest.title: StoreDollChatMessageRequest

StoreDollDraftRequest.description:
The Doll shares a versioned draft (docs/api/dolls.md § POST /drafts).

`draft_payload.body` is a Tiptap document; it is read raw in the controller
and sanitised there — `validated()` would prune the nested node tree, the
same reason `LetterController::store()` reads its body off the request.

`version` is assigned server-side: letting the client pick it invites two
drafts claiming to be v3.
StoreDollDraftRequest.title: StoreDollDraftRequest

StoreDollProfileRequest.description:
Requests the Doll role. Creates `doll_profiles` unverified — staff activate
it by hand (docs/api/dolls.md).
StoreDollProfileRequest.title: StoreDollProfileRequest

StoreDollRequestRequest.description:
`doll_handle` deviates from the contract's literal `doll_id` (docs/api/dolls.md)
— the client never has the Doll's raw user id, only the public handle shown
in the directory. The controller resolves it server-side.
StoreDollRequestRequest.title: StoreDollRequestRequest

reportable_id.description:
El cliente nunca tiene el uuid de una persona: sólo su handle
público. Para `user` se acepta `reportable_handle` en su lugar,
misma desviación que ya hacen /blocks y /doll-requests.

trigger_type.description:
Only date-triggered schedules in Fase 2; posthumous/inactivity
(with its legal notice) is Fase 4.

UpdateLetterRequest.description: Autosave: the front sends partial updates every ~5 s (docs/api/cartas.md).
UpdateLetterRequest.title: UpdateLetterRequest

UpdatePostRequest.description:
Only the light-touch fields are editable after creation — not the type, the
source letter or the body (re-editing text would need re-moderation).
UpdatePostRequest.title: UpdatePostRequest

UpdateScheduleRequest.description:
Editable after creation: the name, the default letter, the send options and
the length. The recurrence shape and the frozen timezone are not — changing
those is a new schedule (docs/api/programaciones.md).
UpdateScheduleRequest.title: UpdateScheduleRequest

accepts_random_letters.description: Canonical home is `users`; surfaced here for the client's convenience.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
